verdict.rationale: Weaviate Cloud offers an 'Always free' 1 cluster tier per user that upgrades to paid anytime, which supports prototyping without payment. However, evidence doesn't detail the free tier's resource limits, duration, or whether it's sufficient for meaningful real-world prototyping, and self-hosted open-source use (free but requiring infra) is a separate path not tied to this pricing claim. missing for 10: details on free tier limits/quotas, independent user confirmation of the free tier being 'meaningful' for real prototyping, comparison to competitor free tiers.
